panel.title: Area of interest
panel.description: Pick an AOI and save it. Restoring it later rebuilds the geometry from the spec alone -- only that small JSON record was written.

section.title: Select
section.description: Save writes {path}. Nothing else on this page reads or writes it, so clearing the AOI leaves the saved one alone.

switch.label: Process a restored AOI automatically
switch.hint: On: Restore draws the AOI straight away. Off: it fills the form and you press Select AOI.
